# Task ADR-071-T2: Two creates of one file are refused

**Depends-on:** none
**Covers:** none — no spec
**Estimated scope:** S
**Owner:** unassigned
**Produces:** the second-create refusal in `planFile`; the case-only collision check in `apply`
**Consumes:** none
**Data dependency:** hermetic
**Proof map:** v1
**Rests-on:** `one create per file`, `names that differ by case are one file`, `two existing files are left to os.SameFile`, `a contract row drives the binary`, `the engine packages are unchanged`

## Goal

Two `create` hunks for one path concatenated their bodies and both reported ok; `n.txt` and
`N.TXT` created in one plan on APFS or NTFS left one file, lost the first body, and exited 0.
Refuse both shapes before anything is written, on every platform.

## Affected Files

| File | Change | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| `internal/apply/apply.go` | edit | the collision pass over the names the plan leaves; the second create in `planFile` |
| `internal/apply/apply.go` | edit | `foldKey` (Unicode simple folding, review B1); the commit guard for a create whose target already exists (review B2) |
| `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | new | the refusals and the pairs that must still apply |
| `scripts/contract.sh` | edit | §141 |

## Ordered Steps

1. [S1] Write the tests; confirm RED. [proof: mutation]
2. [S2] Implement both checks; GREEN; the ADR-021 tests stay green. [proof: mutation]
   Mutants: the second-create check dropped; the lowercase comparison replaced by string equality; the "at least one does not exist yet" condition dropped (two existing files are refused).
3. [S3] Contract §141 drives the built binary: two creates of different names apply; one path created twice and `n.txt` + `N.TXT` each exit 1 with no file on disk and both names in the refusal. [proof: acceptance]

## Acceptance

```bash
set -o pipefail
go test ./internal/apply/ -count=1 -timeout 120s -run 'TestTwoCreates|TestAPathCreatedTwice|TestACreateBesideAnExisting|TestAPlanThatNamesOneFileTwice|TestTheCaseComparison|TestACollisionTheNamesCannotShow' -v 2>&1 | tee /tmp/adr071-T2.out \
  && missing=$(for t in TestTwoCreatesThatCouldBeOneFileAreRefused TestAPathCreatedTwiceIsRefused TestACreateBesideAnExistingFileOfAnotherCaseIsRefused TestTwoCreatesOfDifferentNamesStillApply TestTheCaseComparisonLeavesTwoExistingFilesToSameFile TestAPlanThatNamesOneFileTwiceIsRefusedWhicheverTheSpelling; do grep -qE "^--- PASS: $t \(" /tmp/adr071-T2.out || echo "$t"; done) \
  && [ -z "$missing" ] \
  && grep -q '^# 141\. ' scripts/contract.sh \
&& git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" -- internal/read ':(exclude)internal/read/read.go' ':(exclude)internal/read/walk.go' internal/plan internal/seen internal/state internal/lines internal/iter internal/check ':(exclude)internal/check/*_test.go' \
  && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- internal/read ':(exclude)internal/read/read.go' ':(exclude)internal/read/walk.go' internal/plan internal/seen internal/state internal/lines internal/iter internal/check ':(exclude)internal/check/*_test.go')" ] \
  && [ "$(grep -cE '^require|^[[:space:]]' go.mod)" = "1" ]
```

## Tests

| Test name | File | Verifies | Covers | Steps |
|-----------|------|----------|--------|-------|
| `TestTwoCreatesThatCouldBeOneFileAreRefused` | `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | `n.txt` + `N.TXT`, and a create beside a rename destination of another case: refused on every platform, nothing on disk | — | S1, S2 |
| `TestAPathCreatedTwiceIsRefused` | `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | two creates of one spelling: refused, no file | — | S1, S2 |
| `TestACreateBesideAnExistingFileOfAnotherCaseIsRefused` | `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | an edit of `A.txt` beside a create of `a.txt`: refused on either kind of filesystem, `A.txt` unchanged | — | S1, S2 |
| `TestTwoCreatesOfDifferentNamesStillApply` | `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | the pair: two different creates, and two existing files that differ by case on a case-sensitive filesystem, still apply | — | S1, S2 |
| `TestTheCaseComparisonLeavesTwoExistingFilesToSameFile` | `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | the rule without the filesystem: two existing names are not compared; one that does not exist yet is. Added after S2, because a case-insensitive runner cannot hold two existing names that differ by case, so the "at least one does not exist" mutant survived every filesystem test here | — | S2 |
| `TestACollisionTheNamesCannotShowIsCaughtAtCommit` | `internal/apply/create_identity_test.go` | where the filesystem folds ß into ss, the second create stops the commit and the first body survives (review of #228, B2); skips where it does not, so it is filtered but not required | — | S2 |
| `TestAPlanThatNamesOneFileTwiceIsRefusedWhicheverTheSpelling` | `internal/apply/apply_test.go` | ADR-021, unchanged | — | S2 |

## Reachability

| Rung | How this task shows it |
|------|------------------------|
| 1 — exists | the two checks |
| 2 — something selects it | every plan passes through `apply`, CLI and MCP |
| 3 — the caller can discover it | the refusal names both plan lines and both names |
| 4 — it is used | the macOS and Windows sessions of the v1.25.1 round lost a body this way |

## Invariants

- Two existing files are compared only by `os.SameFile` (ADR-021).
- A case-only rename is not compared with its own source.

## Risks

- A case-sensitive plan that creates two names differing only by case is refused; the message says why.

## Out of Scope

- Folding trailing dots, spaces or `:` streams (permanent: boundary: on POSIX they are different names; on Windows T3 refuses them)

## Stop Condition

Stop if the check needs a filesystem probe.
